_doc: Models scripted production may render on. A new model = new entry: its loader must export verify/checkSpec/boot/applyV3 like training-human-v3-armfix-r2/loader.mjs and return {profile,version} from applyV3. List the authoring models whose recipes it can render in compatibleWith, and only the recipe components it really supports (prefix:* = every variant). A skin-only change needs no new model; add a file under skins/ instead.
